result.title: PhyDiCT: Plug-and-Play CT Reconstruction from Sparse X-Rays via Differentiable Rendering and Strong Priors
result.comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026; to appear in LNCS 16888
result.summary: Reconstructing 3D Computed Tomography (CT) images from a few X-ray projections is a highly ill-posed inverse problem due to the loss of volumetric information. We propose PhyDiCT, a training-free framework that integrates a differentiable Physics-based forward model, grounded in the Beer-Lambert law, with a text-conditioned Diffusion as a strong prior to reconstruct 3D lung CT images. We refer to our approach as training-free since the prior model is used without fine-tuning, and our goal is to steer the denoising procedure to generate samples consistent with X-ray observations. We guide the diffusion generation using Split Gibbs sampling to jointly optimize for projection fidelity (reward) and consistency with prior knowledge. Also, we introduce a test-time refinement step that enhances image realism and anatomical coherence. We extensively evaluate our method on publicly available 3D CT datasets using both perceptual and semantic metrics, demonstrating that it surpasses existing plug-and-play diffusion and fully trained reconstruction approaches. Our findings highlight that combining a strong generative prior with the underlying physics of image formation substantially improves reconstruction quality, e.g., 7.5\% improvement on SSIM compared to full training methods. Code will be released at https://github.com/batmanlab/PhyDiCT.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 3D 肺部 CT 稀疏视角重建框架 PhyDiCT，将基于 Beer-Lambert 定律的可微前向物理模型与文本条件扩散先验结合，用 Split Gibbs 采样联合优化投影保真度与先验一致性，并加入测试时精修。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作面向医学 CT 逆问题的扩散先验引导采样，未涉及 VLM 推理状态、视觉证据筛选或 latent reasoning，与 LVR 主线缺乏实质联系；可微前向模型与测试时引导虽属生成式优化，但无具体可迁移到多模态推理的线索。
